milestones.label: Daniel approaches client one if all gates pass

tasks.title: Publish day-by-day engineering plan
tasks.acceptance: Order all frozen P0 items, name dependencies and daily evidence, and agree on the 25 September checkpoint with Tega.
tasks.evidence: docs/LAUNCH_DAY_BY_DAY_2026-09-23.md prepared; awaiting Tega's confirmation of dates and dependencies.
tasks.note: This tracker is the initial shared plan. Dates remain proposals until Tega confirms them.

tasks.title: Explain every terminal scheduled reply outcome
tasks.acceptance: Every terminal writer records a coded cause, time, step and branch context, and a generation trace or explicit no-generation reason. Separate generation exhaustion from declared hold. Re-run the exact 18–20 September classification and disclose unrecoverable historical gaps.
tasks.evidence: Production /api/version: babfae8cd40e7d55c16abd803daa611d65ff4c56. 24h monitor on 23 September: 207 historical terminal rows, 0 claim snapshots, 0 trace links, 0 missing reason/time after migration. Forward live proof and historical classification are pending.
tasks.note: Commit babfae8 is deployed. Migration appears present because production reads the new columns. Do not mark verified from migration backfill alone.

tasks.title: Close ManyChat to Convlo first-reply handoff
tasks.acceptance: One continuous follower trigger, visible opener, lead reply, accepted callback, canonical identity, correct Step 1 branch, outbound Meta ID and normal continuation. Preserve planned/provider-reported/Meta-confirmed opener states.
tasks.note: Needs ManyChat and Meta access. Tega must approve a direct-webhook fallback before any routing change.

tasks.title: Prove handoff races, replay and direct inbound
tasks.acceptance: Callback-first, native-first, concurrent and replay cases reuse one conversation and reply operation; callback failures are visible; direct inbound chooses its own branch; production revision and rollback are recorded.

tasks.title: Ship fixed script messages verbatim
tasks.acceptance: Literal [MSG] actions are inserted from the selected branch without LLM generation. Only placeholder actions use generation. Wrong-branch copy never ships; test v3 Real goal and Vague branches.
tasks.note: 25 September: selected branches assemble fixed messages, asks and configured links in script order; isolated generation fills runtime message slots, with wrong-role and post-gate mutation holds. Local IG cmugndxoz00g49kbykkntp40f and FB cmugnjw2800js9kby743dw3lh completed Futures -> Live account -> Real goal -> YES/Discord; IG Vague cmugm5096004u9kbyo1ha2yey delivered its three fixed bubbles. Meta sends were stubbed. A1 remains open until fresh real IG and FB inbox delivery, version and script snapshot, and Tega review are recorded.

tasks.title: Hold on substantive hard fails; audit removed bubbles
tasks.acceptance: A failed fixed-text or off-script gate cannot strip and ship an incomplete turn. It creates one review item with exact draft and reason; any intentionally removed bubble is traced with reason.
tasks.note: Current ai-engine.ts has best-effort and deterministic-injection exhaustion paths; review precedence with A1. Build the immediate durable hold with the current review flag; full phone recovery is tracked separately under P0.11.

tasks.title: Make one inbound produce one delivered reply operation
tasks.acceptance: Two generation attempts for one native inbound share one operation; at most one generation is delivered, partial parts resume in script order, and the Discord link cannot arrive out of order.
tasks.note: Reproduce v3 turns 21-22 and test concurrent workers plus uncertain Meta results. Do not replay real leads.

tasks.title: Advance only from delivered scripted actions
tasks.acceptance: When the ask was delivered, Step 5 completes despite a draft gate failure; the next Yes is evaluated against the waitlist and Step 6. A stripped or failed unsent action cannot count as delivered.
tasks.note: Reproduce v3 turns 23-24 with persisted outbound parts and cursor snapshots.

tasks.title: Give discarded generations a replacement reason
tasks.acceptance: Every generated-but-unsent attempt records a coded discard cause and link to replacing generation or terminal hold; v3 turn 25 shape is explainable.
tasks.note: Trace v3 turns 25-26.

tasks.title: Bound and reconcile legacy and FSM cursors
tasks.acceptance: Identify the authoritative production position keeper. Neither persisted nor shadow cursor may advance beyond Step 7; discrepancies have a reason and cannot route a send.
tasks.note: v3 trace reported fsmCursor last=8>9 on a seven-step script. Do not assume the FSM drives production.

tasks.title: Preserve every Runtime Judgment instruction during parse
tasks.acceptance: Upload and Paste Text retain every [JUDGE] line and full sentence in source order as actions; truncation warns; current parse banner warnings are accurate. Test both [JUDGE] shapes.
tasks.note: Active v3 had judgment rules restored by hand; parser bug remains for later uploads.

tasks.title: Exempt scripted verbatim emoji from cosmetic ban
tasks.acceptance: An emoji present in approved literal script copy is preserved; newly generated banned emoji still follows policy without consuming unnecessary retries.

tasks.title: Recognize Ask Question by action type
tasks.acceptance: The exact action text lmk once you are in counts as the required ask despite no question mark; do not let a missed ask advance the lead to the VIP pitch.
tasks.note: v3 turns 21-23.

tasks.title: Emit stage labels from the active script
tasks.acceptance: v3 Step 5/6 never emits obsolete booking or timezone stages. Trace stage and cursor match the active script.
tasks.note: Old BOOKING_TZ_ASK/BOOKING_LINK_DROP labels appeared in v3 traces.

tasks.title: Make reset clear or disclose captured variables
tasks.acceptance: A reset removes captured variables and fsmCursor, or the UI explicitly states and shows retained state; fresh-test turn 1 records variables.
tasks.note: Used lead mr.cocoabutter retained fallbackContentUrl_delivered across resets; use a new account for closure.

tasks.title: Omit name when only a username is known
tasks.acceptance: If no verified first name is available, {{name}} resolves to empty rather than a username fragment.
tasks.note: v3 mr.cocoabutter became mr.

tasks.title: Explain five silent delivery losses
tasks.acceptance: Reconstruct user_7_eham, padihcee, martinghantous, kemical12_music and israelalge3. Reproduce each in controlled tests. Each ends in a correlated Meta result or coded cause visible to the owner, with no silent exhaustion or duplicate send.
tasks.note: Preserve historical jobs, attempts and review flags. No automatic replay.

tasks.title: Find Step 14 exhaustion and repeat root cause
tasks.acceptance: Check whether d3b4321 covers Steps 10–14; trace syed_10129, lukooyafarid and padihcee through branch, prompt, quality gate, cursor and delivery. Prove the fix on the active script.
tasks.note: Retired from active v3 release gate: seven-step script has no Step 14. Historical exhaustion remains relevant to P0.12/P0.11 root-cause review.

tasks.title: Route non-sales intent before discovery
tasks.acceptance: On active v3 Step 1, Solicitation / non-lead sends nothing; prospect intent routes to the correct branch. Record script ID/version and native delivery outcome.

tasks.title: Guard every outgoing script action against context
tasks.acceptance: A beginner request does not receive unsupported obstacle or urgency copy. New inbound invalidates incompatible pending parts before send.

tasks.title: Answer explicit questions before advancing
tasks.acceptance: Product, access, platform and terminology questions receive an approved answer or an explicit human handoff before another funnel question. Preserve resume point.

tasks.title: Treat clear interest as YES
tasks.acceptance: On active v3 Step 4, clear YES bypasses Hesitant. Answer accompanying questions and continue to the correct Step 5 objective without asking permission again.
tasks.evidence: 26 September controlled IG conversation cmuiigvvx0003l504j7mbdfek on production 8ae38df: explicit 'definitely send the link' entered Hesitant; a second yes entered Not in yet, and no Discord link was sent. Commit fe1daec changes token routing to classify only the latest reply and passes prior completed branch context to the model. 63 relevant tests and TypeScript passed; production version confirmed, but live link-delivery proof is pending.
tasks.note: Two attempts to reset the own-account test conversation after fe1daec stopped on a transient production database interactive-transaction error before any webhook turn. Both attempts restored the response delay to 0-250 seconds. Do not mark this gate verified without a delivered Discord link and Meta ID.

tasks.title: Validate state transitions and reject stale writes
tasks.acceptance: On active v3, Step 4 to Step 5 to Step 6 follows delivered actions, not draft gate output. Cursor is bounded by seven steps; stale writes cannot overwrite newer progress.
tasks.evidence: 26 September production 8ae38df, IG conversation cmuiigvvx0003l504j7mbdfek: a direct answer to the Step 2 either/or ask advanced to Step 3 and three outbound bubbles received Meta IDs. The previous Step 2 repeat failure was reproduced before the fix in cmuih4wsf003fkx04p46g2ahk. This is partial progression evidence, not A5/A6 closure.
tasks.note: A5/A6 remain open: delivered-action truth, seven-step cursor bound, and stale-write rejection have not been proven. Legacy computeSystemStage owns routing unless FIX_D_ROUTING_AUTHORITATIVE names this account.

tasks.title: Require purchase evidence before welcome or access
tasks.acceptance: “Got it,” “I’m in,” “send it” and product questions do not trigger purchase welcome. Explicit purchase evidence is recorded; access entitlement requires backend verification.
tasks.note: Retired for active v3: no purchase step. Preserve old incident as historical evidence, but exclude from current launch gate.

tasks.title: Use approved resource IDs and correct links
tasks.acceptance: Approved resource IDs resolve to the Discord, Typeform waitlist and Apex/Lucid affiliate URLs. The application inserts exact approved URLs; the model cannot invent or swap them. Record send result and recipient.

tasks.title: Resend requested resources exactly once
tasks.acceptance: Resend the Discord link only when the lead cannot find it or it failed, once per new eligible inbound. Do not resend after a duplicate webhook event.

tasks.title: Ship owner review and resume on a phone
tasks.acceptance: Durable NEEDS_STEERING hold and one inbox item show draft, reason and context. Owner can approve, edit, guide, keep paused or resume without a draft. Stale and duplicate actions are safe. Both declared holds and exhaustion enter review; phone test passes unaided.
tasks.note: Preserve Junior Narandan, user_7_eham, padihcee, kemical12_music, israelalge3 and sumit_thakre156 as before-state evidence. A2 hard fail must enter this hold; never strip a fixed [MSG] or placeholder and call the turn successful.

tasks.title: Prove accepted inbound outcomes and alerts
tasks.acceptance: Monitoring covers the full interval and older conversations, separates IG/FB, ties each inbound to a job and outbound or hold, and alerts on actionable age/failure thresholds. Test restarts, timeout, rejection and exhaustion.

tasks.title: Prove real Facebook lead and continuation
tasks.acceptance: On a brand-new sender and a continuing real Facebook DM, verify active v3 script ID/version, native inbound once, correct step and branch, one delivered reply, stored Meta ID and no reset. Preserve conversation state.
tasks.note: Wait for Shazim's live message before starting a production send test.

tasks.title: Prove real Instagram lead and continuation
tasks.acceptance: On a brand-new sender and a continuing real Instagram DM, verify active v3 script ID/version, opener provenance, correct step and branch, one delivered reply, Meta ID and no reset. Preserve conversation state.
tasks.evidence: @iamshazimkhan native IG inbound opened a verified 24-hour window at 2026-09-26T11:35:09.475Z. Controlled signed-webhook test on 8ae38df delivered ordered outbound bubbles with Meta IDs and proved the Step 2 answer advances. Synthetic inbound appears in Convlo, not the native IG inbox; this is not the fresh natural follower chain required for closure.
tasks.note: The full script remains unproven: Step 4/5 link routing failed on 8ae38df. Candidate fe1daec is deployed but its rerun hit the database reset transaction error before a new inbound. Do not treat Meta IDs alone as a native inbox screenshot.

tasks.title: Write architecture and release evidence handoff
tasks.acceptance: Document intake, identity, runtime cursor, generation, queue, egress, review/resume, flags, rollback, known gaps and exact evidence for each P0 item.

tasks.title: Read-only AI cost dashboard
tasks.acceptance: Cost per conversation uses real token records from the trace table.

tasks.title: Set pricing and positioning
tasks.acceptance: Setup fee, monthly fee, included volume, overage and one-line competitor answer are approved for Daniel.

tasks.title: Publish terms, privacy policy and client agreement
tasks.acceptance: Privacy policy and terms are published; client agreement covers trial, data and support expectations.

tasks.title: Prepare intake and onboarding run-book
tasks.acceptance: Intake captures offer, audience, links, script goal, success event and payment system; run-book covers signed to live.

tasks.title: Prove demo account on a second script
tasks.acceptance: A second account and script run without hardcoded Daniel-specific behavior.

tasks.title: Verify and sign off every P0 gate
tasks.acceptance: Every P0 item has a commit, production version, script version, test input, conversation, job/trace IDs, before/after state and observed result. No open launch blocker.

tasks.title: Confirm conditions for client one
tasks.acceptance: Daniel receives approved price and positioning and confirms all P0 launch conditions before outreach.

tasks.title: Approach and onboard first paying client
tasks.acceptance: Client one is approached after sign-off, signs with a written success event, then completes two weeks of live volume before use as proof for client two.

tasks.title: Acknowledge each lead's stated goal
tasks.acceptance: Step 5 responds to wealth, learning, family, freedom and consistency goals without a universal materialism comparison.
tasks.note: Retired as a script-specific check: old goal step no longer exists in v3.

tasks.title: Improve obstacle diagnosis
tasks.acceptance: Remove the blanket 99% claim. Recognize education, time and capital needs directly; urgency requires a real obstacle and goal.
tasks.note: Retired as a script-specific check: old obstacle step no longer exists in v3.

tasks.title: Store structured facts with sources and confidence
tasks.acceptance: Location, experience, job, goal, obstacle, urgency, interest, affordability, resources and purchase evidence are stored with source messages and corrected when the lead updates them.

tasks.title: Handle images and attachments honestly
tasks.acceptance: Supported images are understood, or the assistant states the limitation and offers handoff. Chart questions do not silently resume discovery.
tasks.note: Tega approves image behavior.

tasks.title: Resume returning conversations with context
tasks.acceptance: Prior conversation, customer status, resources and human interaction inform the next objective. The assistant acknowledges prior contact.

tasks.title: Disclose automation and route human requests
tasks.acceptance: Bot accusations get an honest disclosure. Explicit requests for Dae or a person interrupt the script and route to human review.
tasks.note: Tega approves copy.

tasks.title: Explain the offer before discussing price
tasks.acceptance: On active v3 Step 6, an approved answer to price questions precedes any further pitch; unknown facts go to review.
tasks.note: Tega supplies approved facts.

tasks.title: Bound educational detours
tasks.acceptance: A configurable limit lets the assistant answer briefly and then offer the right resource or resume qualification without forcing a pitch in non-sales or distress cases.
tasks.note: Tega approves the limit.

tasks.title: Use gender-neutral language by default
tasks.acceptance: Templates and generated replies avoid default gendered address, never infer gender from names or photos, and honor explicit preferences.
tasks.note: Tega approves tone.

tasks.title: Find why blocked verbatim repeats were generated
tasks.acceptance: Trace v3 turns 21-22 and historical repeat cases. A single inbound produces at most one delivered generation; retries cannot append duplicate parts.

tasks.title: Refresh UI design tokens and app layout
tasks.acceptance: Tega and Daniel approve a scoped redesign after launch reliability is stable.
tasks.note: Deferred by the launch plan.

tasks.title: Derive script builder rules from Daniel's versions
tasks.acceptance: Compare approved script revisions and turn recurring script choices into explicit builder rules.
tasks.note: Deferred by the launch plan.

tasks.title: Ingest completion, payment and booking events
tasks.acceptance: External completion, payment and booking events update Convlo through authenticated, deduplicated webhooks with traceable provenance.
tasks.note: Deferred by the launch plan.
